gettingStarted.a1: Choose a document type from the home page or sidebar, enter your topic, and click Generate. No sign-up is required to begin.
gettingStarted.a2: No account is required to generate documents. Sign in with Google to save projects to the cloud, track your history, and unlock higher usage limits.
gettingStarted.a3: Yes - all features are free with a daily generation limit. Premium plans remove limits and unlock priority processing. You can also support development via Buy Me a Coffee.
gettingStarted.q4: Can I use AcademicGen on mobile?
gettingStarted.a4: Absolutely. The platform is fully responsive and works on all devices from mobile phones (320 px wide) to ultra-wide monitors.

documents.q1: What types of documents can I generate?
documents.a1: Technical Reports, Custom Reports, Template Reports, PowerPoint Presentations, Conference Papers (IEEE format), Thesis & Dissertations (Harvard format), AI Images, and more.
documents.a2: DOCX (Word), PPTX (PowerPoint), PDF, HTML, BibTeX, RIS, CSV, PNG, JPEG, and WEBP - depending on the document type.
documents.q3: Is there a word or page limit for generated documents?
documents.a3: You can choose from preset length options (2-5 pages, 6-10 pages, 11-20 pages, 20+ pages) or let the AI decide automatically based on your topic.
documents.q4: Can I regenerate a single section without restarting?
documents.a4: Yes. Each section in Technical Reports, Thesis, and Conference Papers has a 'Regenerate' button that rewrites only that section while keeping the rest intact.
documents.q5: Can I upload my own files as context?
documents.a5: Yes. You can upload PDF, DOCX, TXT files, or images. The extracted text is used as additional context to guide the AI generation.

ai.a1: Document generation is powered by Google Gemini 2.5 Flash. Image generation uses Pollinations.ai (free) with Pixabay as a fallback.
ai.q2: How does the AI Humanizer work?
ai.a2: The Humanizer rewrites AI-generated text sentence by sentence to sound natural and human-written, then scores each sentence for AI probability so you can target remaining flagged parts.
ai.q3: How does the Citation Checker work?
ai.a3: The Citation Checker scans your document for fake, hallucinated, or misformatted references. It supports IEEE, APA, Harvard, MLA, Chicago, and Vancouver styles.
ai.a4: APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, IEEE, and Vancouver. The system can also auto-detect the appropriate style for your document type.
ai.q5: Can the AI read my document aloud?
ai.a5: Yes. Every generator and tool includes a Text-to-Speech reader powered by Azure Neural HD voices and a browser-based fallback. You can choose voice, speed, and engine.

account.q1: Are my documents stored on your servers?
account.a1: No. Documents are generated in real time and delivered directly to you. Uploaded files are processed temporarily and deleted immediately after extraction.
account.a2: Signed-in users can save documents to Firebase Firestore. Saved documents appear in My Projects, where you can reload or export them at any time.
account.q3: How do I delete my account and data?
account.a3: Contact us via the Contact page and we will delete your account and all associated data within 30 days.
account.a4: You can support the project by upgrading to a paid plan on the Pricing page, sharing it with others, or leaving a review. Every bit of support helps keep the service running.

about.title: About AcademicGen
about.tagline: A unified platform for academic AI tools — generate reports, presentations, conference papers, and theses; humanize AI text with bypass detection scoring; validate citations for fake references; generate images; and read everything aloud with Azure Neural HD voices.
about.authorBio: HNK is a Computer Engineer based in Cape Town, South Africa, with a versatile skill set spanning software development, scientific computing, network infrastructure, electronics and embedded systems.
about.authorRole: Full-Stack Developer · Cape Town, South Africa
about.authorHardwareDesc: Tech consulting and development services — from embedded systems to full-stack web applications.
about.docType1Desc: Generate comprehensive BET-standard technical reports with proper structure, citations, and formatting.
about.docType2Desc: Create fully customizable reports with flexible sections, custom formatting, and structure.
about.docType3Desc: Create professional slide decks with speaker notes, visual prompts, and TTS coaching support.
about.docType4Desc: Produce IEEE-formatted conference papers with two-column layout and academic citations.
about.docType5Desc: Generate Harvard-style thesis documents with front matter, chapters, and bibliography.
about.docType6Desc: Create stunning AI-generated images from text descriptions using free pollinations.ai service.
about.docType7Desc: Manage citations with smart import from URLs, DOIs, and BibTeX. Export in multiple citation styles.
about.docType8Desc: Humanize AI-generated text to bypass detection tools (GPTZero, Turnitin, Originality.ai) with per-sentence AI scoring.
about.docType9Desc: Scan documents for fake, incorrect, or misformatted citations. Supports IEEE, APA, Harvard, MLA, Chicago, and Vancouver.
about.platformFeature1Desc: Upload PDF, DOCX, TXT files or images to extract content and use as context for generation.
about.platformFeature2Desc: Save your projects to Firebase cloud storage and access them from anywhere.
about.platformFeature3Desc: Get help navigating the platform with our built-in AI chatbot powered by Gemini.
about.platformFeature4Desc: Organize and manage all your generated documents in one place with the Projects page.
about.platformFeature5Desc: See your document being generated in real-time with live preview as content is created.
about.platformFeature6Desc: Works seamlessly on all devices from mobile phones (320px) to ultra-wide monitors.
about.cap4: 6 Citation Styles (APA, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, IEEE, Vancouver)
about.cap5: Multi-Format Export (HTML, DOCX, PPTX, PDF, BibTeX)
about.cap6: File Upload Processing (PDF, DOCX, TXT, Images)
about.cap9: AI Text Humanizer with Per-Sentence Detection
about.cap10: Citation Checker with Fake Reference Detection
about.cap11: Azure Neural HD Text-to-Speech on All Tools
